dek: The following is issued on behalf of the Liquor Licensing Board: The Liquor Licensing Board will meet on Tuesday (August 11) to consider an application for renewal of liquor licence, and an application for amendment (change of premises address description and addition of a new portion to licensed premises) and renewal
